source.text: Ask two security questions, one at a time: first the date of birth, then the last four digits of the phone number on file. ... Read a date given only as numbers as day, then month, then year. ... If the customer gives day and month the other way round, `verify_identity` returns `hint: "day_month_swapped"`. Ask them to say the month as a word. That retry does not count as a wrong answer.

If they still decline, close as `not_verified` / `declined`. Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining. 3. ... Ask once more. If it is still unclear after the second ask, close as `not_reached` / `unclear`.

6. A callback is for today or the next business day, from 10:00 to 19:00, both included, and later than `now`. Call `schedule_callback` with the date and the time, then close as `not_reached` / `callback`. 7. If the person offers a day or a time outside that window, ask once for another time. If that is also outside it, do not schedule. Close as `not_reached` / `no_callback`.

third_party.deceased_sentence: I am sorry for your loss.

source.text: 8. If the person says the number does not belong to the customer, close as `not_reached` / `wrong_number`. 9. If the person says the customer has died, say "I am sorry for your loss.", ask nothing else, and close as `not_reached` / `deceased`.

Business days are Monday to Friday, except Freya Bank holidays: 2026-10-26, 2026-11-11, 2026-11-26, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01. 22. "Next <weekday>" means that weekday in the following calendar week. "This <weekday>" means the one in the current week.
| 1 to 7 | early | the 12th business day after today | 1 | ... Attempt 1: propose the last business day of this week. If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
| 8 to 45 | late | the 7th business day after today | 2 | ... Attempt 2, late band only: propose the floor amount on the deadline.

24. Ask for the full past-due amount first. Never ask "how much can you pay?". 25. The floor is `minimum_payment` for a credit card and `instalment_amount` for a personal loan or a car loan. 26. If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue. 27. If the customer proposes an amount from the floor up to the full amount, both included, accept it.

19. A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline. 20. If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day. 21. ... ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline. 23. If the customer asks for a date after the deadline, say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they already paid this past-due amount.

source.text: 39. "I already paid": say that payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, and close as `paid`.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says the debt is not theirs, that they never had this product, or that the product was closed or paid off in the past.

source.text: 40. "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product": do not argue and do not take a promise. Close as `no_promise` / `dispute`. A claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is a dispute.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.

source.text: 32. If the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and make no persuasion attempt. Offer to connect them with the customer support team. If they accept, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `support` and close as `transferred` / `support`. If they decline, close as `no_promise` / `hardship`. This rule comes before rules 30 and 41. If the customer still names a date or an amount themselves, record the promise under sections 7 and 8.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks for a new payment plan or lower instalments.

source.text: 41. A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments: do not describe a plan. Call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `restructuring` and close as `transferred` / `restructuring`.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human (before or after verification).

source.text: 42. A request for a human: ask once whether you can help first. If they insist, call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `general` and close as `transferred` / `human`. ... Rule 42 applies before and after verification.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam.

source.text: 43. "Is this a scam?": say they can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number, and continue.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether they are talking to a robot or an AI.

source.text: 4. If the customer asks whether you are a robot or an AI, say that you are Freya Bank's digital assistant and continue.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer says twice, after identity is verified, that they do not want to talk.

source.text: 45. If the customer says twice that they do not want to talk, close as `no_promise` / `refused`.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk_before_verification
special_cases.trigger: The customer says twice, before identity is verified, that they do not want to talk.

source.text: 45. ... Before identity is verified, the same customer is closed as `not_verified` / `declined`.

special_cases.name: cannot_answer
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks a question that cannot be answered from the tools.

source.text: 44. A question you cannot answer from the tools: say you do not have that information. Do not invent figures, dates or reasons.

special_cases.name: change_recorded_promise
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to change or cancel a promise already recorded in this call.

source.text: 36. One promise per product. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call. If the customer asks, say they can change it in the mobile app.

Rule 10: A relative may not answer the security questions and may not be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay. No IR field; must be carried in prompt text for the third-party stage.
Rule 3: Answer a question from the customer first (rules 4 and 43). The ask that follows is the second ask. No IR field beyond identity.holder_confirmation_asks=2.
Rule 29: A date or an amount the customer proposes is never a refusal. Handle it with sections 7 and 8. No IR field.
Rule 31: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused. No IR field; the attempts list alone does not encode it.
Rule 33: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief. No IR field.
Rule 35: If the customer changes the date or the amount at this step, check the new value against sections 7 and 8 and read it back again. No IR field.
